body:
maria_cs: FYI - BlueHarbor goes live tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Drafting a short customer-facing runbook for the call: prefill enabled, tenant cache, small interactive batches, streaming on. Posting the quick runbook below.

jon_eng: nice. can you list exact UI toggles so the enablement engineer can set them during the call?

maria_cs: sure. Console toggles: 
- Prefill: ON (prefill.scope = tenant)
- Cache TTL: 300s (cache.ttl=300)
- Batching: adaptive, max_tokens=200, window_ms=25
- Streaming: ON (streaming.enabled=true)
- Warm pool: min_instances=1, burst=4

sam_sre: for resilience add these infra checks: health_probe -> /_prefill_status, alert if prefill_fail_rate > 4%, and configure trace id on prefill requests as `X-Prefill-Id`.

leah_pm: renewal metrics to capture in the account card: median TTFB, 95th percentile latency, avg tokens/session, and prefill success rate. Proposed renewal flag: any 2 of {median TTFB > 350ms for 2 checks, prefill success rate < 92% for 24h, quality regressions flagged by CS eval} -> trigger AE outreach.

maria_cs: draft customer note for onboarding email: "We preload common prompts to reduce startup latency. You can opt out of prefill in Settings > Data & Prefill." Keep language opt-out? legal prefers opt-in so change to: "You can enable prefill to improve latency; we'll ask for consent during setup."

jon_eng: operational note: if their prompts include large static system messages (>1200 tokens) auto-route to the large-seq serving lane to avoid memory pressure. Also set `streaming.fallback=true` for flaky networks.

sam_sre: add runbook step: run the probe script and paste the trace link into the Notion row. If streaming drops, enable polling fallback and collect logs: `/var/log/prefill/*.log`. Also set an ephemeral debug flag `prefill.debug=true` for a short window.

maria_cs: field checklist for the customer call (10:30 PT):
1) Confirm customer consent recorded for prefill
2) Toggle prefill & tenant cache
3) Verify warm pool shows at least 1 instance
4) Execute probe script and confirm streaming chunked output
5) Add feedback row in Notion with trace link and time

leah_pm: sample probe (share on the call):
```bash
# streaming probe
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Ping","stream":true}'
```

jon_eng: if they experience increased latency during ramp, temporarily reduce batching.window_ms to 10ms and set batching.max_tokens=80 for interactive routes.

maria_cs: proposed simple risk scoring for renewal outreach: 0-100 health score computed from latency(40%), prefill_success(30%), usage_trend(30%). If score < 55 or drops 15 points MoM -> AE + Solutions Eng touch.

sam_sre: alerting: page oncall if prefill_fail_rate > 5% for 1h OR warm_pool_unavailable for any tenant during business hours. Also add a daily digest for CS with top 10 tenants by prefill errors.

maria_cs: I'll fold these into the customer runbook and send the BlueHarbor onboarding packet after the call. tagging @jon_eng @sam_sre @leah_pm for review :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled 07:30 UTC. Canary 3% -> 25% -> 100% over 40m.

jon_eng: ack. quick Q - where do we track the feedback artifacts? Notion still?

maria_cs: yes Notion page: https://redwood.in/notion/cs-onboard-feedback. Please create a row with columns: tenant, engineer, result, trace_link, notes, timestamp.

leah_pm: one last content note: legal prefers explicit opt-in for prefill. Update the onboarding checkbox copy to: "I consent to prefill of my prompts to improve latency".

maria_cs: will update copy and push runbook edits by EOD.
